enchant_cap_policy.eterna_ceiling: 100 by source branch default, may be lower at actual world tier
enchant_cap_policy.enchantability_boost: Apothic Enchanting 1.6.4 may roll +1 beyond Apothic max (1.6.1 feature); distinguish from Iesnium +1
enchant_cap_policy.configured_max: source function or data-map per enchant; cannot substitute vanilla level max; do not claim a universal one-to-one level for every enchant
enchant_cap_policy.iesnium_rule: max allowed for fresh equal-level merge = ApothicEnchantingIntegration.getApothicMaxLevel(enchantment)+1 at exact Occultism 1.227.0 release commit; no unconstrained repeated +1s
enchant_cap_policy.level_cap: strict enforced caps can limit even bonuses; distinguish stored enchantment level, effective level after affix/gems, and gameplay effect
enchant_cap_policy.compatibility: vanilla/mod enchanted item support and incompatibilities checked even by Iesnium; high-level book might be different from item applicable
enchant_cap_policy.derivation: In pinned Apothic Enchanting 1.6.4 source, default maximum is the last enchant level whose power function does not exceed 200. For level > vanilla max: vanilla min-cost base + slope*(level-1) + slope*truncate((level-vanillaMax)^1.6). Derived vanilla 1.21.1 enchant definitions are Fortune base15 slope9/max3, Efficiency base1 slope10/max5, Sharpness base1 slope11/max5, Protection base1 slope11/max4. Actual enchant-info overrides, strict level caps, slots and effective gem behavior still need runtime verification.
